comment: Response decoding (behaviour.md §6, types.md §1): calling method with args against a server answering status + body must decode ("ok", each probe matching), raise a ServerError ("serverError"), or, for a getByReference on an empty page, a NotFoundError with status 404 and code not_found ("notFound").
